main.description: Slippy-tile (z/x/y) vector tile endpoint. Converts z/x/y to Web-Mercator bbox and returns per-label GeoJSON FeatureCollections from vertex_spatial with lod-adaptive Douglas-Peucker simplification. Stable URL key (Option C — foundation for edge MVT tile server).

x.description: Tile x coord in slippy-tile scheme.

y.description: Tile y coord in slippy-tile scheme.

labels.description: Graph node labels to fetch (e.g. Place, Road, Building, AdminArea).

layers.description: { [label]: GeoJSON FeatureCollection } — one entry per requested label with matching features.

tile.description: Echoed { z, x, y } slippy-tile coords.
